tips.text: Hit anything with Cunning Sweep to unlock Sundering Slam. Aim so the enemy is at the outer edge of the sweep for extra damage.
Right-click toward your target while an ability is being cast. Drakehound's Step dashes you in afterward and powers up your next attack.
Start Lacerate and queue a dash to chase. She spins a second time when she lands, and enemies hit are slowed.
Cast Repudiation just as an enemy champion is about to hit you. The shield soaks the hit and the slam that follows deals more damage.
Public Execution jumps to the farthest enemy champion in the line, so check who is behind the others before you cast it.
Watch your energy. Every ability costs energy, but empowered attacks from Drakehound's Step give it back, so attack between casts.

combos.name: Double Lacerate
combos.when: When you want extra damage and a slow from one Lacerate cast.
combos.text: Queue a right-click during the Lacerate lockout. She dashes, then spins a second time on arrival for free, and the dash can chase or kite.

combos.name: Repudiation dash smash
combos.when: When you brace through enemy damage and want the smash to land on a target that is out of range.
combos.text: Queue a dash toward the enemy during the brace. If the brace ends during the dash, the smash lands at the destination.

tips.text: Cast an ability, then right-click toward your target before the cast ends. Drakehound's Step dashes you in and your next attack hits harder and refunds energy.
Hit an enemy with Cunning Sweep, then follow with Sundering Slam soon after. Aim the edge of the sweep at the target, since it hits hardest there.
Use Lacerate to leave an enemy slowed, then dash with Drakehound's Step. Lacerate spins a second time when you land, at no extra cost.
Cast Repudiation just before you take a hit from an enemy champion, a large monster or a tower. The shield absorbs it and the slam hits harder.
Cunning Sweep and Sundering Slam deal bonus damage to monsters. Use them to speed up camps, but watch your energy.
Public Execution blinks you to the farthest enemy champion in a line. You can't be pushed around while you hold them.
Don't cast Public Execution on an enemy who has a spell shield. The cast is blocked and you won't grab them.
Dodge The Darkin Blade by moving to the side; the blades are telegraphed and the final cast is a circle.
Walk sideways or toward Aatrox to leave Infernal Chains before the pull lands.
Use Lacerate to slow Aatrox, then dash with Drakehound's Step for a second spin.
Aim Cunning Sweep so the outer edge hits Aatrox for double damage, then follow with Sundering Slam.
Stay out of range while World Ender is active; he is faster and can revive off kills.
Use Repudiation when Briar jumps on you; its shield and bigger slam hit harder if she hits you while you brace.
Slow Briar with Lacerate when she charges in. Her Blood Frenzy forces her to chase one target, so you can pull her around.
Chain Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam; the edge of the sweep hits hardest, so aim to catch her there.
Don't stand still when Briar is charging Chilling Scream; the full charge knocks you back and stuns you if you hit a wall.
Her Head Rush stun is short and she can't heal while you are ahead. Trade right after it, then hold back until her bleed is gone.
Keep away from Apprehend; once Darius pulls you in, trades go his way. Fight when it is on cooldown.
Use Lacerate to slow Darius when he comes in, then dash away with Drakehound's Step so you are not caught.
Poke with Cunning Sweep at the tip of its range, then follow with Sundering Slam; stay out of melee range.
Time Repudiation to land just as Darius hits you, so the shield holds and the slam hits harder.
Do not let Darius stack up Hemorrhage on you; when he is at full stacks, back off, since Noxian Guillotine can finish you.
Don't cast Lacerate or Public Execution into a ready Riposte. Wait for the parry to end, or bait it first with a cheap ability.
Fiora wants Vital hits and quick trades. Move so the Vital isn't facing her, and punish her when she lunges in.
Chain Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam to poke her. Hit with the edge for extra damage.
Lacerate slows Fiora. Use it to stop her escaping on her Vital Move Speed, then follow with your damage.
Close in with Cunning Sweep, then follow with Sundering Slam while it is ready. Aim so the edge of the sweep hits him for full damage.
Hit Gangplank with Lacerate to slow him, then keep attacking. He cannot kite you easily once he is slowed.
Stay away from his Powder Keg when he can shoot it; the blast slows you and hurts. Walk around kegs or attack them yourself to defuse them.
Wait for Remove Scurvy to be used before you try to lock him down, since it clears slows and stuns.
Use Public Execution to jump on him when he is low; you cannot be stopped during the cast and it ends the fight.
Use Repudiation when he is shooting you; taking his damage while bracing makes the smash hit harder.
Hit Garen with the edge of Cunning Sweep for extra damage, then follow with Sundering Slam while it is ready.
Wait until Garen uses Decisive Strike before you trade. Its silence stops your abilities, so stay out of his reach while it is ready.
Lacerate slows Garen, but Decisive Strike removes it. Use it to set up the fight rather than to stop his charge.
Leave Judgment's range or put minions between you; it hurts most when you are the only target.
Keep hitting Garen so Perseverance stays off, and do not let him walk away to heal.
Dash in with Drakehound's Step right after an ability so Jayce has less time to hit you with Shock Blast.
Use Lacerate to leave Jayce slowed when you close in; it spins a second time if you dash.
Cast Repudiation as Jayce hits you; the shield absorbs his damage and your slam hits harder.
Stay out of his line when Jayce is in Cannon form; Shock Blast hits the first enemy it meets, so keep minions between you.
Play safe once Jayce leads, as he is strong early; save Public Execution for when he is hurt.
Stay out of Ntofo Strikes range until you can dodge it; two hits make the next one stun and pull you in.
Use Lacerate to slow K'Sante when he walks up, then dash out with Drakehound's Step for a second spin.
Cast Repudiation as K'Sante hits you; the shield blocks his damage and your slam hits harder.
Hit with Cunning Sweep, then follow with Sundering Slam while it is ready.
Hold Public Execution for when K'Sante goes All Out; he is much squishier then and you can finish him.
Don't stand still in Seismic Shard range; if it lands you are slowed and Malphite speeds past you.
Use Repudiation to take a poke from Malphite; the shield absorbs it and the slam hits harder if a champion damaged you.
Trade when Granite Shield is down, since Malphite's Armor is much lower without it.
Keep Lacerate for when Malphite uses Unstoppable Force; the slow helps you get away from his allies.
Stay out of Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise aura. Trade in short bursts and step back before it builds up.
Watch for Death's Grasp when you go in. Stay out of its line, or it pulls you into his aura.
Use Repudiation when his Obliterate or Death's Grasp is about to land. Taking a hit from a champion while you brace makes your slam hit harder.
Use Lacerate to leave if he pulls or catches you. It slows him, so you can get away.
Do not trade into a full Indestructible shield. Wait until it has been used or has faded.
Dodge or bait Electro Harpoon before you step in; it slows you and lowers your Magic Resist.
Use Lacerate to slow Rumble when he is close, then follow with Cunning Sweep.
Hit Rumble when he is Overheating; he cannot cast spells then, so go in for the trade.
Step out of the fire from The Equalizer fast; staying in it deals heavy damage and slows you.
Use Repudiation when you take Rumble's hits; the shield blocks damage, and her smash hits harder if it did.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range when Sion starts charging. Move sideways, since the long charge makes the stun far worse.
Use Cunning Sweep and then Sundering Slam so the edge of the strike hits Sion. Sion has a lot of Health, so your damage based on his Health hits hard.
Hit Sion with Lacerate to slow him, then walk away from his follow-up. The slow gets weaker quickly, so trade right away.
Use Repudiation when Sion commits to a Roar of the Slayer or his axe swing, so the shield soaks damage and your slam hits harder.
When Sion's shield from Soul Furnace is up, wait for it to blow up or break before you step in to trade.
When Sion dies, back off from his frenzy from Glory in Death instead of finishing the fight. Use Public Execution on him only when it will kill.
Walk up when Blinding Dart is on cooldown; being blinded makes your attacks miss and ruins your trade.
Use Lacerate to slow Teemo once you are close, so he can't back away from your follow-up.
Walk around likely mushroom spots rather than straight through them; a trap slows you and reveals you.
Hit Teemo with Cunning Sweep's outer edge for full damage, then follow with Sundering Slam.
Use Public Execution to reach Teemo once he is low or out of position; he is fragile and has little to stop you.
Look for Public Execution when Vayne steps forward. It lets you blink to her, and she dies quickly once caught.
Use Lacerate to slow Vayne when you go in. She cannot easily walk away from you.
Do not fight beside walls. Condemn knocks you back into terrain for damage and a stun.
Use Repudiation to shield yourself when Vayne attacks you. The shield also protects you from her Silver Bolts burst.
Start trades with Cunning Sweep, hitting with the edge of the strike for extra damage. Follow with Sundering Slam while it is ready.
Use Repudiation when Yone is about to hit you. The shield absorbs his damage, and the slam then hits harder.
Hit Yone with Lacerate when he dashes in with Mortal Steel. It slows him so you can trade or leave.
Do not chase Yone while he is in spirit form. When Soul Unbound ends he returns to his body and repeats part of his damage.
Aim Public Execution at Yone after he has used his abilities. At level 6 you can blink to him and stun him.
Dash in with Public Execution to grab Graves; he is fragile and cannot escape while suppressed.
Use Lacerate when you reach Graves so he cannot run, then follow with Cunning Sweep and Sundering Slam.
Brace with Repudiation when Graves shoots you; the shield absorbs the hit and the slam hits harder.
Step out of Smoke Screen quickly; leaving it ends the slow and restores your sight.
Sidestep End of the Line and do not stay in its trail, since it explodes along its path after a short time.
Fight Graves when Quickdraw is on cooldown; without his dash he is easy to catch.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike along that line knocks you up.
Use Lacerate to slow Jarvan when he dives in, then trade with Cunning Sweep while he is slowed.
Use Repudiation to take Jarvan's burst. The shield absorbs damage and your slam hits harder if it blocks a champion's damage.
Dodge Blade's Reach; if it misses, Kayn cannot use Umbral Trespass from long range.
Hit Kayn while he is in Shadow Step to cut it short, and stun him with Public Execution to end it at once.
Cast Repudiation as Kayn dives in; the shield soaks his burst and the slam hits harder if he hit you during the brace.
Slow Kayn with Lacerate when he tries to leave, then chase him down.
Watch for the terrain warning near you; Kayn may be about to step out of a wall onto you.
Stay close to your minions and allies. Kha'Zix does much more damage with Taste Their Fear to anyone who is isolated.
Use Lacerate when he jumps on you. It slows him heavily, which gives you room to fight back or walk away.
Cast Repudiation as he commits. The shield soaks his burst, and the slam hits harder if he hurt you while you braced.
Hit him with Public Execution while Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown, because he has little way to escape.
Hit Kindred with Lacerate when you reach her, so she is slowed and cannot kite you. Dash in and spin again.
Use Public Execution on Kindred when she has no safe escape; she is fragile and it lifts her out of the fight.
Wait for Lamb's Respite to end before you finish a target. Nobody inside can die while it lasts.
Use Repudiation when Kindred or Wolf is about to hit you, so the shield soaks it and your slam hits harder.
Cast Repudiation as Lee Sin dives in. If the shield soaks damage from him while you brace, the slam hits harder.
Use Lacerate when Lee Sin engages. It slows him, and you can dash after it to spin a second time.
Stay spread from your team so Dragon's Rage can't knock Ambessa into allies. Lee Sin relies on chaining abilities, so bait out Sonic Wave first.
Hit Lee Sin with Cunning Sweep's outer edge, then follow with Sundering Slam. Both hit harder against a target with a lot of health.
Do not count on Lacerate to slow Master Yi while Highlander is active. Use Public Execution to stop him instead.
Hit Master Yi with Public Execution when he is on top of you. He is suppressed and cannot dodge with Alpha Strike.
Take Master Yi's first hit with Repudiation up. The shield absorbs it and your slam hits harder.
Hit Master Yi a few times while he heals so Meditate costs him mana. Do not chase a healing Yi.
Hold Public Execution until Naafiri commits with Hounds' Pursuit; the cast makes Ambessa unstoppable, so you can punish her.
Lacerate slows Naafiri when she closes in, so use it to catch her or to peel her off you.
Cast Repudiation as Naafiri hits you; the shield soaks her damage and the slam hits harder.
Don't chase when Naafiri vanishes with The Call of the Pack; she can't be targeted for a moment, so hold your abilities until she reappears.
Bait Shroud of Darkness before using Public Execution, since a spell shield stops it completely.
Use Lacerate when Nocturne dashes in so he is slowed, then dash out with her step and spin again.
Stay out of Unspeakable Horror's range; if you walk away while the tether holds, the fear never lands.
When Paranoia is cast, stay near your team; Nocturne's dash goes after whoever is alone.
Use Repudiation when Nocturne hits you; it shields you and hits harder if you braced against his damage.
Hit Shyvana with Lacerate to slow her when she runs at you, then pull away from her fight.
Hold Repudiation until Shyvana attacks you; if the shield takes her hit, the slam hurts more.
Harass Shyvana with Cunning Sweep, hitting with the outer edge, while her Dragon Fury is low. She is weak when kept at a distance.
Use Public Execution on Shyvana when she is out of Dragon Form; she is unstoppable once transformed and the fight tilts against you.
Slow Skarner with Lacerate when he charges in; it gives you room to back off.
Do not fight near walls when Skarner has Ixtal's Impact ready; a wall slam stuns you.
Use Repudiation when Skarner hits you; the shield soaks his damage and your slam hits harder.
Skarner's Impale can be dodged. Dash away with Drakehound's Step after a cast to stay out of reach.
Hold Repudiation until Sylas commits to a lunge or chain pull; the shield and bigger slam punish him for hitting you.
Stay out of Chain Lash range, then close in with Lacerate to slow him so he can't escape.
Sylas can steal Public Execution, so use it to finish a kill rather than to start a fight.
Sylas heals from Kingslayer, so keep hitting him with Cunning Sweep and Sundering Slam to finish him before he heals back up.
Use Lacerate when Talon jumps in. It slows him and cuts off his escape.
Cast Repudiation as Talon commits. If he hits you during the brace, the slam deals more damage.
Use Public Execution on Talon once he is committed. He can't use Assassin's Path to get away while he is suppressed.
Stack up armor against Talon, because all of his damage is physical. He bursts you down quickly if you ignore this.
Cast Lacerate when Viego jumps in; it slows him, and the dash after it adds a second spin.
Sidestep or block Spectral Maw; it stuns the first enemy it hits, and a longer charge stuns longer. Stay behind minions to soak it.
Watch for mist where Viego has cast Harrowed Path; he can sit hidden in it and then attack. Be careful near walls with mist.
Cast Repudiation as Viego commits to a trade; its shield soaks his hits and the slam hits harder if you were hit.
Hit Viego with Cunning Sweep's outer edge, then follow with Sundering Slam while it is ready.
Do not fight beside a fresh kill; if Viego takes one, he can possess the fallen champion and fight with their abilities.
Keep Lacerate for when Xin Zhao jumps on you. It slows him, and its second spin after your dash hits him again.
Cast Repudiation as Xin Zhao dives in. The shield soaks his hits and the stronger slam punishes him for it.
Stay out of his Three Talon Strike combo. The third hit knocks you up, so trade away from him when you see him charge.
Use Public Execution on Xin Zhao after he spends Crescent Guard, because it can be blocked by his untouchable window. Do it when he has used his burst.
